name: Citizenship by Birth and Descent

requirements.blocker_text: Born on or after 7 January 1993 with at least one parent or grandparent who is a Ghanaian citizen -- applies whether the applicant is born in Ghana or abroad.

evidence_required.document: Documentary proof of parent's or grandparent's Ghanaian citizenship

sources.title: Ghana Citizenship (private legal-service site) -- Ghana Citizenship Act 2000 (Act 591), Section 7: a person born on or after 7 January 1993 with at least one Ghanaian parent or grandparent qualifies for citizenship automatically, whether born in Ghana or abroad; earlier constitutional periods (Sections 3-6) carry different rules not detailed in this build

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ghana). STATUS: DRAFT -- only a private legal-service site (tier 3) was located with this level of section-by-section detail in the time available; Ghana's own Attorney-General's Department / Judicial Service legislative repositories were not successfully fetched in this build. The pre-1993 rules (Sections 3-6, covering citizenship at Ghana's 1957 independence and subsequent constitutional transitions) are genuinely more complicated and were not modeled here -- a real, disclosed simplification rather than an assumption that the modern rule applies retroactively. dual_citizenship_allowed set to TRUE per Ghana's 2000 Act (Section 16), which permits dual nationality generally, subject to 13 senior public offices requiring sole Ghanaian citizenship (President, Speaker, Chief Justice, service chiefs, and similar) -- disclosed here rather than modeled as a route-blocking condition, since it affects only a narrow set of public offices, not ordinary life, work, or residence.
